title: Jim Harbaugh to address offense during bye week after Chargers' 0-6 start

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jim Harbaugh to address offense during bye week after Chargers' 0-6 start
sources.description: The Los Angeles Chargers fell to 0-6 following a 22-6 loss to the AFC West rival Kansas City Chiefs at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday, Oct. 18.
